label: About
title: About The Weight Between
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1217 recent saved-signal files and 879 captured links, then narrowed the page to 7 source windows around Salvador Dalí - Crucifixion (Corpus Hypercubus) - The Metropolitan Museum of Art and "Posi" - Lotus (Hideo Kobayashi, DJ MIK, DJ NATSU), plus 5 more. A source image from collectionapi.metmuseum.org helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Weight Between: Nocturnal suspended geometry, a cinematic still in frontal theatrical tableau, low receding ground and unequal depths. Split ochre cubes into broad near and narrow distant assemblies; stretch a softly modeled, bifurcating ivory gesture across their dark interval. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 7 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Stepped black rupture within the upper-left gold assembly, Interrupted checkerboard platform edge, and Narrow recessed joint within the right gold assembly.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
